QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] Archon and the Argent Guard
QuestInfo.0: The man who rescued you from the dark monster seems to be quite concerned about the injuries you and your sisters sustained.
QuestInfo.1: Use the potion he gave you to heal your wounds.
QuestInfo.2: The dark monster you encountered on the way to Katanos reminded you of the mysterious voice you heard when you were a child, and resembled the enemies that attacked your home soon after. After meeting #p9201713# that day, you dreamed of joining the Argent Guard.

defaultEx.0: Is something the matter? Perhaps you should into it before things get worse.
